shortDescription: Define and display stats for the current ansible run

options.name: aggregate
options.description: Whether the provided value is aggregated to the existing stat V(true) or will replace it V(false).

options.name: data
options.description: A dictionary of which each key represents a stat (or variable) you want to keep track of.

options.name: per_host
options.description: Whether the stats are per host or for all hosts in the run.
